label: LLM
description: AI language model completion. Which service serves it comes from a wired provider node (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, or a custom endpoint); sampling parameters come from a wired LlmParams node, and without one the defaults apply. Conversations chain through the history ports; wired LLM Tool declarations turn on tool calling.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The prompt to send, appended as the newest user message. Optional when a history is wired (a tool-result round re-enters with the history alone).

inputs.name: history
inputs.description: The conversation so far (a Chat Message chain or a previous call's history output).

inputs.name: media
inputs.description: Media attached to this prompt: one stored image, audio clip, or video, or a list of them.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: The provider (wire an OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, or Custom Provider node's output): which service, which model, whose credential the call spends.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Optional LlmParams node carrying the sampling settings (system prompt, temperature, ...). Unwired, the defaults apply.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Tool declarations the model may call: one LLM Tool node's output, or a list of them.

inputs.name: toolChoice
inputs.label: Tool choice
inputs.description: Only used when tools are wired: auto lets the model decide, required forces a call, none forbids one.

inputs.name: parseJson
inputs.label: Parse JSON
inputs.description: Parse and repair JSON from the response (changes output to Dict). With it on, declare output ports named after the JSON's keys (`-> (verdict: String, score: Number)`) and each key comes out as its own port; `response` then only matters when something reads the whole object.

inputs.name: autoCache
inputs.label: Automatic prompt caching
inputs.description: On: when the wired history carries no cache mark, the request marks the system message and the last history message before this call's new turn, so a chain of calls reuses its stable prefix. The marks live on the request alone: the `history` output carries the conversation as written, so the next call in the chain places its own. A history that already carries marks (Chat Message's `cacheBreakpoint`) is sent as placed.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The reply. Declare its type in the source: `String` without parseJson; with parseJson, prefer one output port per JSON key (`-> (verdict: String)`) and read `response` only when something needs the whole object (then `JsonDict` or a record type).

outputs.name: history
outputs.description: The conversation including this call: the input history plus the new user message and the assistant reply. Wire it onward to continue the conversation.

outputs.name: toolCalls
outputs.description: The tool calls the model made, if any (each with the raw JSON text of its arguments). Pulses only when the model called tools; append each result with a Chat Message node (role: tool) and wire the history back into the next LLM call.
